Under the supervision of the Sr. Workforce Relations Manager, the Workforce Relations Coordinator primarily supports the Workforce Relations Investigations team in delivering consistent, high-quality labor and employee relations services across the UCI enterprise. Applies employee relations policies and procedures to coordinate investigation activities of moderate scope and complexity throughout the full investigative cycle. Conducts preliminary intake meetings with reporting parties to gather initial information. Assists investigators with evidence preparation by collecting, organizing, and documenting relevant materials to ensure a complete and accurate investigative record. Drafts investigation-related notices and correspondence to involved parties with attention to accuracy, confidentiality, and timeliness. Coordinates and schedules investigative interviews and related meetings, managing logistics to support efficient case progression and timely resolution.

Coordinates the enterprise-wide investigation data workflow, including case data entry and tracking in ServiceNow. Conducts analyses of employee relations issues, investigations, and other Workforce Relations data to identify trends and areas of risk or opportunity, and develops and delivers related reports and presentations.

Responds to misconduct review requests by reviewing Workforce Relations data and coordinating with the Office of Equal Opportunity and Diversity (OEOD) on current and former UCI employees seeking UC employment, and may coordinate responses to other charges and claims as applicable. Partners with HR teams and enterprise stakeholders to ensure investigative processes are documented accurately, timely, and in accordance with applicable legal, regulatory, and procedural requirements. Assists with strike planning and provides onsite support during labor activity. Maintains sensitive employee records with strict confidentiality, exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action, and escalates complex matters to management.
Provides additional support to the entire Workforce Relations team as needed, including in the areas of labor and employee relations and policy and compliance.
Strong attention to detail in documentation and recordkeeping.
Proficiency with ServiceNow.
Proficiency with case management systems and Microsoft Excel for data tracking, analysis, and reporting.

This position may be required to report at different work sites including Irvine, Orange, and other locations. The incumbent must be able to provide their own means of transportation to/from work locations.
Demonstrated organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills to conduct analysis and develop recommendations.
Knowledge of union / labor contracts.
Working knowledge of other areas of HR.
Knowledge of organizational policies and procedures; knowledge of functional area and understands how work impacts other areas.
Knowledge of applicable state and federal laws and regulations.
Knowledge of employee relations practices and programs.
Effective written and oral communication skills.
Demonstrated ability to handle difficult or volatile situations / individuals effectively.
Demonstrated ability to apply employee relations specific concepts.
Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion with sensitive information.
